title: Ultimi miei sospiri (Verdelot)
desc: Philippe Verdelot, Ultimi miei sospiri, before 1546. 6 voices (Cantus, Altus, Quintus, Tenor, Sextus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0038); edited by Brian Marble, Michael Winter, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
